text:
alan (infra): kickoff: planning a coordinated tf apply for networking + iam across eu-west-1 and us-east-1 on 2025-01-15T04:00Z (change window). will do provider pin and micro-canary in eu-west-1 first. posting plan here.

jess (platform): love the micro-canary. ensure `required_providers { aws = { version = "~> 4.76" } }` in root. also add a module-level `provider_lock = true` flag in release config.

nina (sre): add safety checks to deploybot: abort if >7% packet loss or control-plane 5xxs increase by +4% over baseline for 3m. include `--dry-run` on canary.

ryan (release): i'll draft release notes and include a security review note for IAM changes. draft link: https://confluence.example.com/display/release/infra-2025-01-15. include who to page on rollback.

alan (infra): rollback criteria: any new deny in critical IAM roles or control-plane 500s -> immediate rollback. rollback owner: nina (sre) until infra oncall picks up. rollback steps in runbook: https://runbook.example.com/tf-rollback-v2

deploybot: [scheduled] deploybot: queued batched apply at 3301009876 (micro-canary eu-west-1). owner: alan. notify: #eng-oncall, #security.

jess (platform): canary plan snippet:
```
terraform plan -target=module.vpc -var=region=eu-west-1 -out=canary.plan
terraform apply -auto-approve canary.plan
```
use `-parallelism=8` and keep timeout 12m for each wave.

nina (sre): after canary, pause 20m. checklist: 1) deploybot success, 2) latency < baseline + 10ms, 3) no 5xx spike, 4) smoke IAM assertions pass. i'll run automated IAM smoke tests.

alan (infra): pause 20m. i'll own wave decisions. if something fails: `deploybot cancel --job 3301009876` then revert to state tag: `terraform state restore -from=tag/2025-01-10`. manual revert instructions in runbook.

ryan (release): added rollback contact: `@sre-oncall` and `@infra-oncall`. release note entry saved.

jess (platform): rotate ephemeral deploy service account keys after each wave: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create --iam-account=deploy-sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com --key-file-type=json` then `vault kv put secret/deploy/sa-key @key.json ttl=3600`.

alan (infra): final: escape hatch = provider-pin to last-known-good commit + manual apply of previous tfstate. if deploybot gets stuck, escalate to oncall, then run `terraform apply -state=previous.tfstate previous-plan` (runbook link above). posting final start at T-15. :thumbsup:

nina (sre): standing by for smoke tests, will page if IAM denies observed. :raised_hands:

ops-bot: Release note saved: infra-2025-01-15: "networking + IAM batched apply; micro-canary eu-west-1; rollback on 5xx or IAM denies; pause 20m between waves."

alan (infra): thanks team. will post `deploybot start` at T-5 and include preflight logs.
